text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the first day of summer camp.
To make the most of our
time, I've gone
ahead and started Daiwa Scarlet on beach
runs.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant... Haaah, aaagh... I'm sweating buckets...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Let me take a quick breather! Sigh... Running on sand really tires you out.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If it didn't,
I'd have some choice words for
you. I'm not trying to waste
all my energy
for no reason, you know.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If anything, I welcome a hurdle or two.
Each obstacle I overcome is
another step
closer to being number one.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'm done resting! Let's get back to
it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's caught her breath,
but I can tell her
balance is a little wobbly. Looks like her
legs are shaky, and I doubt this heat is
doing her any favors either.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Were you even listening to me just
now?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I said I welcome challenges! We're at
summer camp, so isn't a tougher
schedule
par for the course?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If I complained about every little thing,
there's no way I could
become number
one!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I don't need you to tell me tha—aah?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Scarlet tries to take a step forward, but
her legs give way beneath
her.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Tch... I can't become number one if I get
exhausted this easily. I have
to do m—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Sigh. Fine, you win. I'll rest a bit more, and then—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Fine, fine. I'll listen to you this time.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I mean, you are my trainer and all. And I
can't stand you worrying
about me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Geez. As soon as I'm back up to snuff,
we're making up for lost
ground.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. I'm not a child, so could you not treat me like one?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If we're done training,
then I'm free for the
rest of the day, right? See
you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a slight wobble in her gait,
she starts
heading back to the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later in the evening, I decide to go check
up on Scarlet. In the dorm
hallway, an
unfamiliar student comes up to me.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Oh hey, you're Scarlet's trainer. Are you
looking for her?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I don't think she's in her room.
I just saw
her heading towards the
entrance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She was pretty beat after today's
training...
Is she going to be okay
walking around by
herself?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it isn't my trainer?
What's that look
on your face for?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I was about to go for a walk an—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I-I don't mind... But,
what're you getting so
worked up for?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me—you're worried I'll sneak in
some training again...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so that's why. Don't worry, I took a
relaxing bath followed by a
nice nap.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Like you said, we have training tomorrow
too. I wouldn't want to
overdo it today and
feel dead tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
But I've got to say... You really are a
worrywart. You know, at first I
thought you
just didn't trust me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
How about this? I'll prove to you that I'm
full of energy and feeling
perfectly fine!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet insists on leading the way,
so I follow along beside
her—when
suddenly—lively festival music starts
playing nearby...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I heard there was a festival going on
nearby, so I was just about to go and
check it out. Hey,
don't all these delicious smells make you
hungry?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Of course it is! A happy stomach is key to
a happy me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's go buy out the food stalls!
Oh, but before that—let's
have some fun!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After taking in the festival,
we load up on food and head to the
beach. Yakisoba,
takoyaki, shaved ice, cotton candy—we
devour them one after the other.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Mmm, that hit the spot! Yum, yum! ♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hey, didn't I tell you earlier? Stop being
such a worrywart already.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I did overwork myself that one time,
but now I'm not alone,
so...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
A-anyways that's how it is,
so I'm fine now!
Got it?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I didn't say it was you I was talking about, did I?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It's just, you are a pro trainer... So I
thought it'd be okay to leave the
training
stuff to you, nothing else.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
B-basically,
you better take responsibility
for what you promised!
You're the one who
said, "Let's become number one together."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
And there you go,
getting all carried away.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'll be way more prepared for tomorrow's
training, so you better not
fall behind
either!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I will become number one—but I can't do it
alone.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That's why... you need to keep up with me
and become the number
one trainer too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Daiwa Scarlet runs with a
newfound resolve beneath
the shining sun,
more dazzling than even the distant
horizon.
